description: Build a link that opens one or more public IFC files in the free IFC Viewer Online 3D viewer (runs in the browser: orbit, section, measure, properties, validation with Health Score badge). Optional: drop them on the city map, isolate a class, pick a camera view, open a floor plan in the drawings pane, add point clouds. Also returns an <iframe> to embed the same view in a web page, wiki or dashboard. Use it whenever the user wants to see, show, share or embed a model in 3D. Give the link to the user to click; this tool does not open a window by itself.

isolate.description: Show only this IFC class, e.g. IfcWall, IfcDoor, IfcSpace.

lang.description: Interface language: en, es, ca, fr, de, it, pt, ja, zh or th.

map.description: Place the models on the 3D city map at their own georeference.

models.description: Public http(s) URLs of IFC files. Several URLs load together as one federated scene. Local paths do not work here: the browser has to download the file.

scans.description: Public point-cloud URLs (LAS/LAZ/E57/PLY…) to load with the models.

ui.description: Interface preset: full (all panels), minimal, kiosk (no chrome), client (read-only for clients), article (for embedding in pages).

view.description: Camera view once the models load.

name: open_in_3d_viewer
title: Open IFC models in the 3D viewer
